title: The Dimension of the Two-Adic Hecke Algebra at Odd Level
summary: OpenAI 数学仓库收录的研究手稿。展开查看英文摘要，或标记后让我进一步解释。
status: AI 产生的研究手稿；收录不表示已完成独立审查或同行评议。
abstractEnglish: For every odd positive integer N, every irreducible component of the full two-adic Hecke algebra of level $`\Gamma_1(N)`$ has Krull dimension four. This proves the p = 2 case of Emerton's dimension conjecture, including all residual components.
